{{Quote|There's always a bigger fish.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|audio=TheresAlwaysABiggerFish-TPM.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''sando aqua monster''' was the largest [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] living in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Little was known about these giant creatures, and there were many myths and legends regarding their origins and habitats. What little was known about them terrified researchers as well as Naboo citizens and denizens across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sando-woswfg.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sando mating dance.]]
Named for its prodigious size and monstrous appetite,<ref name="SWE-sando aqua monster">{{SWE|characters|sandoaquamonster|sando aqua monster}}</ref> the sando aqua monster had a long, sinewy body that was almost [[Feline/Legends|feline]] in appearance, with hind [[Limb/Legends|legs]] used for movement on the ocean floor and massive finned claws to propel it through the [[Water/Legends|water]]. Lacking a layer of fat or [[blubber]], it was poorly streamlined, and not fully adapted to swimming. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] could reach over 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, with females being at least 150 meters in length.<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Being [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]],<ref name="NoP" /> females nursed their young for about a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Females bore only one pup per birth. The average lifespan of a sando was thought to have been several hundred years,<ref name=":0" /> although their elusiveness made any accurate study difficult. In order to maintain their large size sands had to constantly eat anything in their path. Because decent-size prey is so scarce, the Sando aqua monster is a lethargic and sluggish animal most of the time, spending 90% of the day lying dormant and motionless.<ref name=":0" />

Their limbs were part flippers, part claws; [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] theorized that they had only recently evolved from land-based ancestors.<ref name=":1">{{DB|creature|sandoaquamonster|sando aqua monster}}</ref> Some believed the large, bulbous organ located toward the end of the sando's tail to be a possible remnant of life on land, though the exact function of the organ is unknown. There were even reports of sando monsters surfacing in swamp lakes and attacking [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpaset]] and [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]] herds, and unsubstantiated reports of them sunning themselves on sandbars.<ref name=":0" /> Unsurprisingly, scientists failed to observe their [[Diet/Legends|eating]] habits, or how the beasts sustained their gargantuan bulk. The sando life cycle was a mystery, as they were dangerous, although reclusive, predators

When it spots its prey (such as [[opee sea killer]]s and [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]]), the sando gets close to it quickly, then opens its large mouth, letting out a roar before biting down. If the prey is small, the sando will swallow it whole. If the prey is large, the sando would either bite it in half or physically tear it in half to stop it from escaping.<ref name="Episode 1" /> To most natives of Naboo, sando aqua monsters were more of a myth than an actual creature, mainly because they had never been observed in the wild and reports of their washed-up carcasses were rare.

This species was affected by various skin parasite, like [[san-lampris]] and [[san-pilot]].<ref name=":0" />

Supposedly, due to certain anatomical similarities, the [[Zalaaca/Legends|zalaaca]] might have been a close relative of the sando aqua monster.

==History==
[[File:Sandoaquamonster.jpg|thumb|250px|A sando uses its massive jaws and limbs to eat its prey.]]
According to [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] mythology, enchanted Sando aqua monsters guarded the underwater [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ossorus]], the residence of the [[Gud/Legends|guds]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

Reports of a sando's washed-up corpse were rare, though [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] encountered a beached sando youngster prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It had been attacked by two [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killers]], and it had surfaced, revealing a secret facility run by a man nicknamed [[Veermok (Naboo)|Veermok]]. The incident was covered up, and the area destroyed.<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}</ref>

While attempting to reach [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] encountered an [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] in their [[Bongo]]. The opee had used its purple prehensile tongue to capture the submersible and pulled it into its mouth. A sando then came around the corner and saw both the fish and sub. It licked its teeth with its beige tongue and opened its mouth, letting out a massive roar before it bit down on the opee, missing the sub. The sando munched on the fish as it feebly tried to escape. Having enough of its unwilling prey, the giant monster stood on its legs and tore the fish in half and devoured it, giving the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] time to flee deeper into the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] core. But the sando saw its dinner escaping and pursued them to a cave. In the cave, they found themselves being pursued by a [[Colo claw fish/Legends|colo claw fish]], but the sando appeared at the cave beginning to block it. It opened its mouth and let out a low roar, preparing to devour the sub but it went upwards. Then the sando saw the claw fish attempting to go around it but the sando turned the same direction it was going. The monster bit down on the claw fish, while the sub escaped the sando's appetite, the claw fish didn't as it was devoured whole in the monster's powerful jaws.<ref name="Episode 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The original concept sketches of the sando aqua monster featured large eyes, which worked against the illusion of massive scale. The creature's head was redesigned with smaller facial features that preserved the monster's apparent size. The sando's muted color palette was inspired by the typical hues of large terrestrial animals, like [[Elephant/Legends|elephants]] and whales.<ref name=":1" />
